</problem>

structured_output.text: This is the Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product conjecture, which is open. The best known lower bounds are around |A|^{4/3+c} for a small explicit c>0 (Solymosi gave 4/3 up to logarithmic factors; Rudnev–Stevens and others improved it slightly; values quoted from memory). The exponent 2 cannot be improved, since for A={1..N} we have |A+A|≈2N and |AA|=N^{2-o(1)}. I cannot prove the 2-ε bound, so the problem is unsolved.
